title: 秋の新作、りんごとくるみのパン
summary: 甘酸っぱいりんごと香ばしいくるみを合わせた季節のパン。

cover.alt: りんごとくるみのパンの断面

en.title: New for autumn: apple and walnut bread
en.summary: A seasonal loaf made with tart apples and fragrant walnuts.
en.cover_alt: A sliced apple and walnut loaf
en.html:
We baked a moist loaf with tangy apples and aromatic walnuts. Little pieces of apple are tucked into the crumb.

How to enjoy it

  • Toast lightly to bring out the aroma
  • Add a little butter
  • Enjoy with your morning coffee
en.markdown:
We baked a moist loaf with tangy apples and aromatic walnuts. Little pieces of apple are tucked into the crumb.

## How to enjoy it

- Toast lightly to bring out the aroma
- Add a little butter
- Enjoy with your morning coffee

![Apple and walnut bread](bakery/apple-bread.webp)

markdown:
りんごのやさしい酸味と、くるみの香ばしさが広がるパンを焼きました。しっとりした生地の中に、角切りのりんごがごろっと入っています。

## おいしい食べ方

- 軽くトーストして香りを引き出す
- バターを少し添える
- 朝のコーヒーと合わせる
